title: 01_dataverse_training
author: Kunal Aarse (kunalinfinite)
cv: OOF Macro-F1 0.8620 ens / 0.8555 Base+ / 0.8499 Large on 824 rows (VERIFIED from notebook output files; optimistic: best epoch chosen on the same fold)
validation: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold, groups = exact PCM duplicates only (near-duplicates straddle folds); 2 conflicting-label rows dropped
model: WavLM Base+ and WavLM Large fine-tuned
preprocessing: 16 kHz, 8 s random crop (train), start/middle/end crops (eval)
features: learned softmax layer weights + attentive statistics pooling
augmentation: mild gain + Gaussian noise (SNR 25-40 dB); SpecAugment-style time masking p=0.03; no pitch/speed
optimizer: AdamW, layer-wise LR decay 0.95, head LR 3e-4 (backbone 2e-5 Base+/1e-5 Large)
hyperparameters: 24 epochs, patience 8, batch 2 x accum 8, dropout 0.25, fp16, grad checkpointing
ensembling: equal-weight probability mean of 10 fold models
runtime: T4; training several hours (UNVERIFIED exact); inference ~4 min
potential_leakage: none found; near-duplicate twins inflate its CV vs a novel-clip estimate
notes: Strongest public end-to-end pipeline; the user's current submission (rank 27) is this notebook's output
